system.description:
You’ve learned how machines work, and you’ve learned how to take them apart.

If you have created a Truth which represents a weakness or flaw you’ve learned about or spotted in a machine, then you — or whichever other character uses that Truth on an attack against that machine — may add +2 to the cost to avoid that attack’s Injury. After an attack has been made using this benefit, the Truth created is removed, as the machine adapts to protect that weakness.
